title: Happy Number
kidExplanation: Story version: A number is a happy number if, after repeatedly replacing it with the sum of the square of its digits, the process eventually reaches 1. To determine if a number is a happy number, we can use Floyd's Cycle Detection Algorithm. We use two pointers: a slow pointer that advances one step at a time and a fast pointer that advances two steps at a time. If the fast pointer eventually reaches the slow pointer, we have a cycle, indicating that the number is not a happy number. (We will slow down and draw it.)
